title: WooCommerce Redesign
meta: A fresh, faster look for your WooCommerce store while keeping every product, page and search setup. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce redesign that keeps your products and rankings
overview: If your shop looks dated or slow, we redesign it without losing what you have. We study your current pages and sales path, agree a new look with you, then rebuild the shop, product, cart and checkout pages on a staging copy. Product data, links and search titles stay put. When you approve it, we move it live, test a full order and check the main pages on a phone.

faq: Will a redesign hurt my sales while it happens?
No. We work on a staging copy and your live shop keeps selling untouched. We switch over only when you approve and after a full test order succeeds.
Do you keep my product data and orders?
Yes. A redesign changes how the store looks, not your products, customers or orders. All of that stays in your database exactly as it is.
Do I need to provide a design?
No. Share a few shops you like, your brand colors and your logo. We propose the layout and refine it with you. If you have Figma designs, we build from them.
Can you change my theme too?
If your theme is slow or outdated, we may suggest a lighter one. We explain why, show you a preview, and only switch with your approval.
